local.execution: Ubuntu24.04 WSL and Linux CI; native Windows SDK only

cloud.release_policy: Server-managed engine patch versions cannot be pinned as a customer cluster runtime. Record actual versions in Phase2, test semantic parity, fail on unexpected breaking API/type behavior. Local4.0 is a test engine, not a claim of identical managed Spark. Align model runtime requirements at Phase8 with persisted MLflow signature/environment.

api_contracts.postgres: 2.0 postgres API; inspect exact operation stability in P09

upgrade: Pin application transitive dependencies at their implementation phase before deploying; no speculative npm/app dependencies installed during design. Each upgrade uses compatibility/fault/security/cost regression and new gate hashes.
